## Fitpal — Reconcile (PROD + DEV)

3rd gate of payment reconciliation. One 15-minute trigger, four calls:
`viva-reconcile` + `airtable-reconcile` on **prod** and on **dev**.

### Runs ALONGSIDE Netlify's own `*/5` cron — on purpose
Measured 2026-09-03 against `reconcile_runs`: Netlify cron *is* firing on prod, but skipped **70 times in 48h, worst gap 25.1 min**. This workflow covers those holes.

Safe to double-fire: `markPaid` is a guarded `UPDATE ... WHERE payment_status='pending'`, so two triggers produce exactly one row change. Only cost is extra `reconcile_runs` rows.

### Error handling is asymmetric, deliberately
The two **DEV** nodes are set to continue on failure — a dev branch-deploy outage must never stop the prod calls in the same execution.
The two **PROD** nodes use the default, so a real prod failure turns the execution **red** and you can see it in Executions.

### ⚠️ Do not edit casually
A manual edit of the old dev-only workflow left `viva-reconcile` untriggered for **17 days** (23 Jun – 10 Jul 2026, found in WEC-532). After ANY change, verify:

```sql
select provider, count(*) as runs_20min, max(run_at) as latest,
       now() - max(run_at) as age
from reconcile_runs
where run_at > now() - interval '20 minutes'
group by provider;
```

Source of truth: `n8n/` in the fitpal-site repo.

Linear: **WEC-534** scheduler cutover · **WEC-646** liveness alerting (STILL MISSING — nothing shouts if this AND Netlify both die) · **WEC-485** Netlify scheduler failure, never root-caused
